subject: Wellington Station Multifamily Overlay District Recommendation
overview: The board finalized and approved its recommendation to the City Council for a new multifamily zoning overlay to comply with the state MBTA Communities Act. The proposal focuses on parcels near Wellington Station, incorporating reduced parking requirements and building height incentives to meet state-mandated housing unit capacity.

items.title: MBTA Communities Zoning Overlay Hearing
items.summary: The board continued its public hearing to refine recommendations for a zoning overlay district required by the MBTA Communities Act.

items.title: Parking and Unit Capacity Modeling
items.summary: Staff presented modeling showing that reducing parking minimums to 0.5 spaces per unit would allow the city to meet its state-mandated capacity of 6,433 units while potentially lowering base building heights.

items.title: Development Feasibility and Parcel Analysis
items.summary: The board reviewed specific parcels near Wellington Station, noting that while the zoning must allow for theoretical capacity, actual development is likely limited to a few specific sites currently used for surface parking.

items.title: Debate on Parking Minimums and Maximums
items.summary: Members discussed balancing the goal of transit-oriented density with the reality of local car dependency, ultimately favoring a reduction of the parking maximum to 1.2 spaces per unit to disincentivize excessive parking infrastructure.

items.title: City-Wide Rezoning Project Update
items.summary: Director Hunt announced the selection of consultants for an 18-month comprehensive city-wide rezoning project intended to align local ordinances with the city's new comprehensive plan.

items.title: Wellington Station Multifamily Overlay Recommendation
items.summary: The board voted to recommend that the City Council adopt the overlay district with amendments setting the parking minimum at 0.5 spaces, the parking maximum at 1.2 spaces, and correcting a clerical error in the use table. Approved.

items.title: Staffing and Miscellaneous Updates
items.summary: Staff provided updates on the hiring of a new housing planner and the recruitment process for economic development leadership roles.
